about_short_description.short_description: Rainforest focuses on providing software platforms for payment processing.

product.name: Rainforest Embedded Payments Platform
product.description: An API-driven payments platform that enables vertical SaaS and other software companies to embed payment acceptance, merchant onboarding, billing, reporting, and payment operations into their applications.

identifier.value: Payment Processing, Settlement and Funding Services

product.name: Payment Processing, Settlement and Funding Services
product.description: Payment infrastructure for processing card, ACH, electronic check, PayPal, and other authorized transactions, then settling and funding proceeds to merchants through sponsor-bank relationships.

identifier.value: Merchant Onboarding, Risk and Payments Operations

product.name: Merchant Onboarding, Risk and Payments Operations
product.description: Operational services and embedded workflows for merchant application, bank verification, underwriting support, payment compliance, fraud controls, chargebacks, and ongoing payments administration.

identifier.value: Platform Success and Payment Strategy Consulting

product.name: Platform Success and Payment Strategy Consulting
product.description: Consultative support for software platforms covering embedded-payments strategy, pricing, implementation, adoption, payment economics, migration, and ongoing technical assistance.
